title: AM-SEV / Tempest v3: KAT-verified AND-RX CSPRNG with verifier engine, certificates, and hardware
description: The complete code and evidence package of the AM-SEV paper: the Tempest v3/v4 CSPRNG (KAT-verified C reference, AVX-512 port, Go math/rand/v2.Source, C++ <random> URBG + GSL gsl_rng_type, Rust rand_core crate, NumPy BitGenerator), the Python verification engine (polar-rank certificates, differential/linear/algebraic metrics, SAT/MILP tools), statistical test logs (NIST SP 800-22, TestU01, PractRand 1 TiB), KAT-verified FPGA RTL with a completed iCE40 bitstream, and the full audit record.
